notes: [P1] untested-wiring: the contextmenu handler in src/main.js returns early unless state.status === 'playing'. Neither that status string nor the cellAt helper appears anywhere in the rendered diffs, and no test covers main.js. If the game's live status value is spelled differently, right-click would silently never toggle and nothing would catch it. Either check that the guard matches the status values game.js actually uses, or drop the guard (the click handler shown in the diff has none in its visible context). A small test of the handler's logic would also help.

[P2] ux-feedback: nothing in the diff changes rendering, so a player who right-clicks a tower cannot see whether it is in 'nearest' or 'first' mode. A visual indicator in render.js would be good to have; the brief does not require one.

[P2] outcome-confirmed: the brief and acceptance criterion are met. firstInRange picks the in-range enemy with the greatest distance and returns null when none qualify. pickTarget treats 'first' as first and anything else, including no mode, as nearest. createTower sets mode 'nearest'. updateTower fires at pickTarget's choice. nextMode is a pure toggle. The contextmenu handler calls preventDefault and toggles the tower found by towerAt. test/targeting-mode.test.js covers every criterion, including updateTower firing at the leading ghost in mode 'first'. The canPlace refactor to use towerAt keeps the same behaviour.
